GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok well back Settled Down 2nd last 6 Lengths 600m 2nd last 5 Lengths Straightened Up last Middle Of Track Straight ran on well final 100m # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Soon after the start shifted out and was contacted on the hindquarter.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Four Wide No Cover (4L from lead). Worked to improve 1 length midrace & pushed to quicken Six Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid in @ 200m. Outgunned in last 150m. Lost near hind plate. # Wide & faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very wide and without cover throughout the event. Lost its near hind plate during the running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat Mid Field Two Wide 4 Lengths 800m, peeled off heels to Middle Of Track soon after Straightening Up , Just did not finish off last 200m # weakened last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that his mount was under pressure from the 600m, however, commenced to give ground in the early part of the home straight and was disappointing in the manner in which it closed off its race. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair drifted back 9l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on ok but no threat # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over the concluding stages had to be eased to avoid the heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 800m, Ridden Along when Leader slipped away Straightening Up but he dug deep last 200m and Kept Coming for brave minor placing # brave chase
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted out and bumped another rnr. Raced keenly in the early stages. Raced wide and without cover in the middle stages. Laid in in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair eased to last 11l off, improved turn, still well off Straightening Up , battled on well without threatening # held ground

Jumped Ok , Not Bustled 2nd last Two Wide 3 Lengths 800m, came 3 Wide before the corner and joined Leaders , Just wanted to lay in at 200m but when balanced-up took over, held margin final stages for tough win # too strong
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race vet exam after horse in adjacent barrier stall was fractious, and was passed fit to start.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow away. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (6L from lead). Stayed same midrace & improving slowly from 700m. Pushed out 3 Wide @ 600m & pushed to quicken Five Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 300m & held ground in last 200m. blinkers off again/ winkers again. # One-paced
Jumped Ok eased near last 10+ Lengths off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, made some ground but never a threat # back/no threat
Bit Slow Out bustled, settled back 8l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, battled on well without threatening # sound
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped with another rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (6L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace until improving Four Wide @ 400m. Pushed out Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & chased soundly in last 200m. # Sound from rear.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow into stride. Laid in under pressure at the entrance to the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Not pushed early & caught Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (3L from lead). Worked fwd to share lead Two Wide midrace & held together =lead Five Wide on home turn. Headed & pressured Six Wide @ 250m & stuck on OK in last 200m. # Worked & faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced very wide and without cover throughout the event.
